OPTIONAL / COMMUNITY REFERENCE CATALOG

Your DNA test covers more genomic positions than our catalog

You have two choices: help add these marker references to the catalog without sharing your personal variant results, which stay with you, or skip looking up these uncovered markers for now. Your existing results remain available either way.

Think of your DNA export as a phonebook lookup. The rsID (for example, rs12345) is the public listing for a genetic marker; the genotype (for example, AG) is your personal result at that marker. The genomic position is the address of the marker in the DNA reference genome, like an address in the phonebook.

Public phonebook referencers12345Eligible for your optional contribution
Your private resultAGNever included in the contribution

We improve the phonebook, not collect your private numbers. We prepare only valid-looking rsIDs missing from our current inventory. No genotypes, alleles, genomic positions, filenames, or demographic details are included.

An rsID list is not completely anonymous: it can reveal which markers your test covers. Nothing is shared unless you explicitly choose to download and submit the list.

Open GitHub contribution issue ↗

Nothing is submitted automatically. Download the list, review it, then attach it to a GitHub issue only if you want to contribute. GitHub issues are public. Submissions are reviewed and validated against dbSNP before any catalog update.

Age, sex assigned at birth, and ancestry can affect how population research applies to people. SNP Reader uses your choices only to explain relevant limitations, not to calculate a disease-risk score or alter ClinVar classifications.

No personal context selected. All genetic evidence remains available.

These values stay in this browser tab. They are not inferred, stored, uploaded, included in exports, or used to generate percentages. Clear data also clears them. Self-described ancestry is not the same as measured genetic ancestry.

01 / DNA REPORTEvidence & health context

ClinVar allele-specific classifications for review. These records are not diagnoses or personal risk estimates.

Your DNA file may contain hundreds of thousands of markers. Only markers with checked, genotype-specific evidence receive interpretations. All other markers remain searchable below as unreviewed raw calls.

Inventory membership does not imply clinical significance. Interpretations are educational summaries, not diagnoses or personalized medical advice. An unlisted or uncalled variant does not establish absence of a trait or condition.

RESEARCH FIRST

Every explanation should have a source.

dbSNP identifies variants; ClinVar records clinical classifications for specific alleles and conditions. The first MVP catalog uses carefully selected NIH genetics explanations. A matching rsID alone is not a medical finding.

NCBI dbSNP ↗ClinVar ↗MedlinePlus Genetics ↗
Important distinction

A genetic association describes research across groups. It does not determine your health, abilities or future. Consumer raw data can contain errors and is not suitable for diagnosis without clinical confirmation.

Your DNA stays on your device.

Your raw DNA file is read and interpreted inside this browser. It is not uploaded to our servers or sent to reference websites. SNP Reader downloads public reference information separately.

No account required. Closing or clearing the page removes your loaded results from the interface.
